findings.message: 3 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Поможем выбрать удобный способ ремонта" → 3 lines (5 words, 60.5px); "Что важно знать перед ремонтом ноутбука" → 4 lines (6 words, 60.5px); "Узнайте стоимость ремонта вашего ноутбука" → 3 lines (5 words, 60.5px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 7 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "в Санкт-Петербурге и Ленинградской области" above "Вернём ноутбук в работу. На понятных вам"; "Позвоните для бесплатной консультации" above "+7 (812) 344-44-44"; "Digma" (pill) above "Выберите способ ремонта"; "Начнём с вашей ситуации" above "Поможем выбрать удобный способ ремонта"; "Понятно на каждом этапе" above "Как проходит ремонт"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ✓
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): div.lr-location-map.lr-location-map--pending → linear-gradient(rgb(217, 226, 236) 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(217, 226, 236) 1px,
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 3 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: strong → rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px 0px 0px 4px | p → rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px 0px 0px 4px | p.lr-caption → rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px 0px 0px 4px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 6 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div#lr-quick-contacts.lr-quick-contacts 1267px | section#lr-symptoms.lr-section.lr-symptoms 1440px | li 614px | li 614px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 51 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 1 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Unreadable text: "Срок уточним при обращении" 1:1 (#0c234b on #0c234b)
findings.fix: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: 3 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: 27 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 52px (3.6vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 629px of the width empty: "Что важно знать о ремонте ноутбука".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: The h1 is 18px ("Ремонт ноутбуков в Санкт-Петербурге и Ленинградско").
findings.fix: Set the title at display size, or make the large text of the first screen the h1.

findings.message: 6 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "Чистка и перегрев" (0px from the right); "Шум, нагрев и выключения под н" (0px from the right); "MacBook" (0px from the right); "После залития водой ноутбук бы" (0px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 768px: "Вернём ноутбук в работу. На понятных вам условия" → 5 lines (8 words, 52px); "Мобильная мастерская у вашего дома" → 3 lines (5 words, 32px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 32px or less.

findings.message: 2 rows of identical boxed cards.
findings.fix: Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: 2 section(s) have content at both edges and 712px of nothing between: "Что случилось с ноутбуком?"; "Ремонт ноутбуков разных производителей"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.
